family_distinction: Ranks BTCUSDT only against ETHUSDT and chooses exactly one atomic portfolio target: BTC, ETH, or cash. The fixed relative-rank primary and fixed subordinate cash filter may never be replaced, promoted from a variant, transformed into independent per-asset time-series rules, or retuned after development. It uses no Donchian breakout, volatility target, single-asset drawdown entry, recovery exit, shorting, dynamic universe, or fitted model.
economic_hypothesis: Persistent cross-asset capital rotation between BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT may make a fixed, causally risk-adjusted multi-horizon relative-strength rank useful enough to beat cash, equal-weight buy-and-hold, and a simpler raw relative-momentum baseline after conservative costs without leverage.

data_contract.universe_claim: No broad cross-sectional or point-in-time market-universe claim; both assets are explicitly fixed before evaluation.

primary_signal.combined_score: arithmetic mean of the three finite per-horizon scores; any missing, zero-volatility, or nonfinite component makes the asset ineligible
primary_signal.relative_gap: higher combined score minus lower combined score
primary_signal.absolute_cash_filter: winner median of its raw 20, 60, and 120 session log returns must be strictly positive
primary_signal.entry_from_cash: target 1.0 in the higher-score asset only when relative_gap is at least 0.25 and the absolute cash filter passes; otherwise target cash
primary_signal.rotation_rule: while long one asset, preserve it unless the other asset exceeds its combined score by at least 0.25 and passes the absolute cash filter, then target the other asset
primary_signal.cash_exit_rule: target cash when the held asset becomes ineligible or its median raw 20, 60, and 120 session log return is less than or equal to zero
primary_signal.tie_rule: an exact score tie targets cash from cash and preserves an existing eligible holding

execution_contract.required_signal_history: for both assets, every completed synchronized UTC session needed by the named trial's longest return horizon and its 20-return volatility window; no forward fill or partial lookback
execution_contract.information_cutoff: for synchronized signal session s, max of both assets' session event timestamps and causal availability timestamps after every required lookback value is complete
execution_contract.canonical_daily_fill: C_s is the single earliest synchronized BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT minute-bar open timestamp strictly greater than signal session s information cutoff; each complete synchronized session has at most one C_s and later intraday opens are never alternative fills
execution_contract.base_execution: after session s completes, compute exactly one atomic decision from the actual target after C_(s-1), queue it unchanged, and execute it at C_s; cost and drift apply once
execution_contract.typical_first_fill_after_midnight_sessio: 00:01:00Z open carried by the 00:02:00Z bar-end record
execution_contract.pending_state: at most one immutable atomic target; signal decisions never supersede it. Only a causally triggered quarantine safety liquidation may cancel a pending entry or replace a pending rotation/exit with cash.
execution_contract.additional_delay_stress: decision from signal session s executes at C_(s+1). At C_s, immutable decision s-1 executes first; using completed session s and the resulting actual state, decision s is then computed once and queued for C_(s+1). The initial eligible session queues without filling, and no intervening decision supersedes a target.
execution_contract.return_interval: one synchronized causal fill vector to the next; no interval may bridge a cash-state quarantine boundary
execution_contract.self_financing: weights include BTC, ETH, and residual cash. For risky returns r_i, G=1+sum_i(w_i*r_i); drifted risky w'_i=w_i*(1+r_i)/G and drifted cash w'_cash=w_cash/G. Turnover=0.5*sum over BTC,ETH,cash of abs(target_j-w'_j). Net wealth W_next=W_start*G*(1-turnover*one_way_cost_rate). Initial entry uses G=1; terminal exit is costed identically.
execution_contract.simultaneous_rotation: BTC-to-ETH or ETH-to-BTC is one atomic rebalance with turnover one under the one-half L1 definition, not two independent portfolios
execution_contract.terminal_cash: identify the last C_s strictly before the half-open evaluation end. Base execution overrides decision s to cash; delayed execution overrides decision s-1 to cash. This ex-ante boundary override is not a signal trial and must execute at that last fill with cost.
quarantine_precedence: detect an incomplete/nonsynchronized signal session or missing/asynchronous canonical fill only when causally knowable
if actual cash with a pending entry, cancel it; carry wealth unchanged in cash, close the prior return segment, record no bridging return interval, and reset signal/regime/recovery history

if actually exposed, cancel any pending entry/rotation/exit and replace it only with a safety cash target at the earliest later synchronized valid fill; retain one labeled quarantine_liquidation interval from the last valid priced fill through that liquidation, including full held-asset return and liquidation cost
after priced liquidation, carry wealth unchanged in cash without return observations, start a new segment only after recovery and the next valid canonical fill
if either endpoint needed to price actual exposure or forced liquidation is unavailable or nonfinite, terminate DATA_INTEGRITY_FAILURE; never invent, omit, or zero-fill exposed PnL
execution_contract.pending_rotation_or_exit_during_quaranti: actual exposure controls precedence: the signal target is canceled and forced cash replaces it; its full economic exposure remains included through the priced liquidation
execution_contract.segment_wealth: ending wealth of a segment is the starting cash wealth of the next segment; cash passage over absent quarantine time creates no return observation and no interval silently bridges the boundary
execution_contract.recovery: when cash at the trigger, recovery starts after that trigger; when exposed, it starts only after the priced forced-liquidation fill. Require 150 consecutive synchronized complete sessions; signal and regime histories rebuild from only that run before a new entry decision.

walk_forward_contract.development_loader_guard: allow only the 36 verified 2024-2025 development partitions and reject every path containing year=2026 before footer or value parsing
walk_forward_contract.aggregate_development_evaluation: one independent run from cash over [2025-01-01T00:00:00Z, 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z), using only pre-2025 development observations for indicator/regime warmup and no PnL before the start
walk_forward_contract.fold_isolation: before invoking any state machine, slice signal sessions, canonical fills, and warmup to development observations whose timestamps are strictly before fold end; no post-fold session, gap, price, or fill can invalidate or alter a fold
walk_forward_contract.fold_start: actual and desired targets, pending state, wealth/PnL, turnover, and entry counts start from cash independently. Signal and regime indicators may warm on earlier allowlisted development observations, but warmup carries no position, pending order, PnL, or prior decision.
walk_forward_contract.first_permissible_decision: the first synchronized signal session at or after fold start for which the named trial's full contiguous lookback, 150-session recovery when applicable, and both-asset eligibility exist; long_60_120_180 requires the current close plus 180 prior synchronized closes and the 20 returns ending at the current session
walk_forward_contract.fold_boundary: half-open; every ordinary interval start and end is at a C_s inside the fold. A retained quarantine_liquidation interval must also liquidate strictly before fold end or the fold terminates DATA_INTEGRITY_FAILURE.
walk_forward_contract.regime_warmup: regime history may warm causally on allowlisted pre-fold development sessions, excludes the current estimate, carries no PnL or position, and resets only on a causal completeness/synchronization gap, not merely at a fold boundary
walk_forward_contract.terminal_target: use the execution_contract terminal_cash rule; the terminal liquidation is included, costed, and must leave exact cash before the end
walk_forward_contract.development_endpoint: no signal session, canonical fill, execution price, return endpoint, or regime observation at or after 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z may enter development
walk_forward_contract.purge_and_embargo: not applicable to fixed lagged deterministic rules after independent cash initialization and strict half-open endpoint enforcement

benchmarks_and_multiplicity.common_trial_rules: unless an override below says otherwise, use the primary eligibility, mean risk-adjusted score, median-positive cash filter, 0.25 gap, state/tie rule, pending/quarantine/execution/cost/fold/terminal/statistical rules unchanged

primary_risk_adjusted_20_60_120.cash_filter: median raw horizon log return strictly positive

raw_60_session_relative_strength_rotatio.cash_filter: winner raw 60-session log return strictly positive

short_10_30_60_horizons.score: mean of per_horizon_score using unchanged 20-return volatility
short_10_30_60_horizons.cash_filter: median raw horizon log return strictly positive

long_60_120_180_horizons.score: mean of per_horizon_score using unchanged 20-return volatility
long_60_120_180_horizons.cash_filter: median raw horizon log return strictly positive

raw_unadjusted_20_60_120.score: arithmetic mean of the three raw horizon log returns without volatility division
raw_unadjusted_20_60_120.cash_filter: median raw horizon log return strictly positive

wide_0_50_rotation_gap.cash_filter: median raw horizon log return strictly positive

benchmarks_and_multiplicity.selection_rule: primary is fixed before development and can never be replaced by a benchmark or variant regardless of observed result

benchmarks.cash_zero_return: one genuine zero return at every ordinary valid canonical interval, no trade or cost; quarantine-absent intervals remain absent
benchmarks.BTCUSDT_buy_and_hold: from cash buy BTC weight one at the first valid C_s in the boundary, drift without rebalancing, liquidate at the same required terminal C_s, charge 14 bps on initial and terminal turnover
benchmarks.ETHUSDT_buy_and_hold: from cash buy ETH weight one at the first valid C_s in the boundary, drift without rebalancing, liquidate at the same required terminal C_s, charge 14 bps on initial and terminal turnover
benchmarks.equal_weight_BTC_ETH_buy_and_hold: from cash buy weights 0.5/0.5 at the first valid C_s, allow weights to drift without rebalancing, liquidate both atomically at the required terminal C_s, charge identical turnover costs
benchmarks.raw_60_session_relative_strength_rotatio: the fully specified identically named trial, including causal fills, state, quarantine, initial/terminal costs, and fold resets

statistical_contract.daily_return_series: all ordinary valid canonical fill-to-fill base intervals including genuine cash zero returns, plus retained priced quarantine_liquidation intervals; cash quarantine spans and every boundary-crossing or unpriceable interval are absent, never zero-filled
statistical_contract.sharpe: mean daily net return divided by sample standard deviation ddof=1 times sqrt(365), risk-free zero; nonfinite or zero-volatility results fail

bootstrap.seed: unsigned first 64 bits of SHA256 UTF-8 experiment_id
bootstrap.confidence_interval: two-sided percentile with NumPy linear interpolation at 0.025 and 0.975
bootstrap.degenerate_rule: fewer than two observations or nonfinite result fails

deflated_sharpe_ratio.observed_daily_sharpe: primary mean divided by sample standard deviation ddof=1
deflated_sharpe_ratio.alternative_daily_sharpes: seven trials on the exact intersection of identical causal interval endpoint timestamps; genuine common cash zeros retained and noncommon/absent quarantine intervals excluded
deflated_sharpe_ratio.benchmark_SR0: sample standard deviation ddof=1 of seven alternative daily Sharpes * ((1-Euler_gamma)*Phi_inverse(1-1/7)+Euler_gamma*Phi_inverse(1-1/(7*e)))
deflated_sharpe_ratio.skew_and_kurtosis: SciPy bias=False and nonexcess kurtosis on the aligned primary series
deflated_sharpe_ratio.dependence_adjustment: none, treating seven trials as independent for conservative maximum multiplicity penalty
deflated_sharpe_ratio.degenerate_rule: T below three, any nonfinite input, zero primary standard deviation, nonpositive/nonfinite denominator, or undefined alternative Sharpe yields probability zero

probability_of_backtest_overfitting.inputs: seven trial returns on the exact common causal endpoint timestamps used by DSR
probability_of_backtest_overfitting.zero_volatility_sharpe: negative infinity unless mean is strictly positive, then positive infinity
probability_of_backtest_overfitting.out_of_sample_rank: average rank from worst one to best seven with tied values receiving their average rank
probability_of_backtest_overfitting.degenerate_rule: fewer than eight common observations, empty block, nonfinite return/rank/logit, or undefined selection yields PBO one

exceptional_profit_limits.scope: aggregate portfolio positive net currency PnL intervals
exceptional_profit_limits.denominator: sum of strictly positive interval net currency PnL

statistical_contract.asset_contribution: for interval wealth W, gross currency PnL for asset i is W_start * drifted_weight_i * asset_return_i; total cost currency is post-gross wealth * turnover * cost_rate and is allocated over BTC/ETH risky legs by abs(target_i-drifted_weight_i)/sum over BTC,ETH of abs(target_j-drifted_weight_j), with zero risky-leg cost when turnover is zero. Cash-to-asset and asset-to-cash cost is fully attributed to that asset; an atomic rotation cost is split across both changed risky legs. Per-asset net contribution is summed gross currency PnL minus allocated currency cost and both must be strictly positive.
statistical_contract.regime_history: use only prior synchronized complete BTC sessions. A 60-session sample volatility estimate needs 60 simple returns; the expanding median at session s excludes s's current estimate and requires at least 120 prior eligible volatility estimates. Any incomplete/nonsynchronized session clears close, volatility-estimate, and median histories; rebuilding uses only the subsequent contiguous run.
statistical_contract.regime_definitions: at interval start C_s use only signal session s: BTC 120-session log return strictly positive is up otherwise down; current eligible 60-session volatility strictly above the median of at least 120 prior eligible estimates is high, equal or below is low
statistical_contract.regime_assignment: assign every ordinary interval and retained quarantine_liquidation interval from its start C_s; genuine cash zeros count when the start regime is eligible, absent quarantine spans do not. A completed entry is assigned to the regime of the decision session that created it.
statistical_contract.regime_eligibility: at least 45 included intervals and at least five completed entries assigned to the regime
statistical_contract.regime_gate: at least three regimes eligible and every eligible regime has strictly positive aggregate net return

trade_and_sensitivity_contract.completed_entry: an actual fill transition from cash or the other asset into the named asset, followed inside the same evaluation boundary by an actual costed rotation away or liquidation to cash
trade_and_sensitivity_contract.completed_hold: the full named-asset exposure from its completed entry fill through its completed exit/rotation fill; a priced quarantine safety liquidation and required terminal liquidation complete a hold, while an unfilled pending target does not
trade_and_sensitivity_contract.rotation_counting: one atomic BTC-to-ETH rotation completes one BTC hold and starts one ETH entry; it is one synchronized portfolio target change, not two portfolio decisions

development_gates_all_required.baseline_superiority: primary net return and Sharpe strictly above raw 60-session rotation and equal-weight buy-and-hold, with primary maximum drawdown strictly below equal-weight buy-and-hold

holdout_contract.open_rule: the reused data contract remains exact PASS, every development gate passes, source code/evidence is clean and committed, and a separate live Sol/xhigh pre-holdout audit returns HOLDOUT_OPEN_APPROVED
holdout_contract.access_record: before parsing any holdout footer or value, commit a record containing source commit, frozen preregistration hash, data-contract hash, exact 12 holdout byte hashes, evaluator-code hashes, seeds, and access timestamp
holdout_contract.one_shot: after the access-record commit, exactly one deterministic holdout evaluation invocation may parse the 12 holdout partitions
holdout_contract.post_access_failure: any read, schema, signal, execution, quarantine, accounting, statistic, or evaluator error after first footer/value access terminates HOLDOUT_EVALUATION_FAILURE; no repair, rerun, reopen, or partial-result selection
holdout_contract.immutability: data, code, primary, all variants, benchmarks, costs, signal/state, execution, quarantine, fold, attribution, statistics, gates, and seeds remain byte/hash identical after access approval
holdout_contract.baseline_superiority: primary net return and Sharpe strictly above raw_60_session_relative_strength_rotation and equal_weight_BTC_ETH_buy_and_hold, with primary maximum drawdown strictly below equal_weight_BTC_ETH_buy_and_hold
holdout_contract.regime_gate: at least three regimes each with at least 45 included intervals and five completed entries; every such eligible regime strictly positive net return

promotion_and_prospective_contract.historical_candidate_freeze: only after every holdout gate and a separate live Sol/xhigh terminal audit pass; freeze source/data/code/config hashes and timestamp while capital remains zero
promotion_and_prospective_contract.prospective_data: every event and availability timestamp must be strictly later than the candidate freeze timestamp
promotion_and_prospective_contract.independent_portfolio_decision: one synchronized frozen target computation after an eligible completed session counts only when the computed desired BTC/ETH/cash target differs from the preceding computed desired target; unchanged reaffirmations and safety liquidations do not count; maximum one count per eligible completed session
promotion_and_prospective_contract.accounting: identical frozen signal, pending, execution, cost, quarantine, self-financing, attribution, statistics, and gates; no refit, adaptive threshold, variant promotion, or gate change
